name: wave-workspace
description: Monorepo for Wave Code CLI and Agent SDK

scripts.ci: pnpm -r --parallel type-check && pnpm -r --parallel lint && pnpm -r --parallel test:coverage
scripts.docs:build: pnpm run docs:screenshots && vitepress build docs
scripts.vsce:run: pnpm -F wave-vsce run compile && LOG_LEVEL=DEBUG code --extensionDevelopmentPath=$(pwd)/packages/vsce --new-window
scripts.vsce:build: pnpm -F wave-webview build && pnpm -F wave-vsce run compile
scripts.desktop:dev: pnpm -F wave-webview build && pnpm -F wave-desktop run dev
scripts.desktop:build: pnpm -F wave-webview build && pnpm -F wave-desktop run compile
scripts.desktop:package: pnpm -F wave-webview build && pnpm -F wave-desktop run dist
scripts.desktop:install: pnpm build && pnpm -F wave-desktop exec electron-builder --dir && rsync -a --delete packages/desktop/release/mac-arm64/Wave.app/ /Applications/Wave.app/
